name: Double Bind

rules: R2 makes X violate another obligation

activation: two or more relevant rules conflict
compliance with one creates violation of another
maintenance: participant keeps searching for a valid first-order move
signatures: every salient move violates another active rule
naming the contradiction is blocked or punished
falsePositives: ordinary dilemma with a permitted choice
temporary ambiguity that can be clarified
conflict where exit is freely available

breakpoints.operation: open meta-communication or change a meta-rule
change or leave the interaction frame
